hero.title: BACK-END DEVELOPER
hero.description: With 2 years of experience in Node.js, MongoDB, and Express, I can build scalable and high-performance applications, applying agile methodologies, clean code, and TDD. Knowledge in Docker, AWS, and Git version control.

hardSkills.heading: My Skills
hardSkills.intro: I have a range of hard skills, grounded in practical experience and formal education. These skills include a strong focus on teamwork, proficiency in agile methodologies, and a commitment to writing clean and sustainable code.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.description: I have great ease in working in teams, aiming for respect and effective communication.

agile.description: I apply agile methodologies, such as Kanban, to manage projects and optimize workflow efficiency.

proactivity.title: Proactivity
proactivity.description: I take initiative in tasks and bug fixes, aiming for effective and timely completion.

newTech.title: New Technologies
newTech.description: I quickly learn new technologies and adapt to new tools and changes, staying updated with the latest market trends.

cleanCode.title: Clean Code
cleanCode.description: I write clean, well-structured, and maintainable code, ensuring long-term scalability.

tdd.title: TDD
tdd.description: I helped implement the TDD methodology in my current job, aiming to deliver sprints with zero bugs!

about.heading: Learn a little about me
about.paragraph1: I started this journey in 2019 when I joined the Information Systems program at university. During this time, I learned a lot about programming, specialized in backend development, and I am currently learning and practicing web development.
about.paragraph2: In addition, I am passionate about learning new things, always seeking to improve myself and stay updated with new technologies.
